job.title: Legal Assistant - Part Time
job.description:
About the Firm
Our client is a leading international law firm with a well-established presence in Sydney and across major markets worldwide. Known locally as a genuine market leader, the firm has built a reputation for its supportive, high-performing culture, offering a professional and collegiate environment where business services and legal support staff are highly valued. With a strong focus on inclusion, wellbeing and flexible ways of working, the firm invests heavily in the growth of its people and prides itself on being a genuinely great place to build a long-term career.

The Role
We are recruiting an experienced Legal Assistant to support the Financial Services practice within a well-regarded Corporate team in Sydney. This part-time role is offered on a parental leave cover contract until September 2027, as part of a job share with another experienced Legal Assistant, supporting two Partners and two Senior Associates.

Working days are fixed at Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday, with Wednesday being a crossover day with your job share partner. This suits a confident, organised Legal Assistant who enjoys being a trusted right-hand to senior lawyers in a fast-paced, high-performing team.

Key Responsibilities
  • Managing diaries, inboxes and workflows, and coordinating day-to-day administrative matters
  • Preparing and managing correspondence, documents and matter files
  • Coordinating meetings, calls, events and travel arrangements
  • Liaising confidently with clients and internal stakeholders
  • Managing billing, including pre-bills, edits, finalisation and cost reporting
  • Monitoring deadlines and following up on outstanding actions
  • Collaborating with other Legal Assistants and Administrative Assistants across the Corporate group
  • Contributing ideas for more efficient ways of working, including technology and AI tools
Candidate Requirements
  • Demonstrated experience as a Legal Assistant or senior legal support professional in a legal or professional services environment
  • Proven experience supporting senior stakeholders, with sound judgement and discretion
  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities and tight deadlines
  • Experience with billing, reporting and matter management systems
  • Previous job share experience desirable but not essential
  • A service-oriented mindset and willingness to mentor junior team members
Why Apply
Join a high-performing, market-leading practice within a truly international firm, working alongside supportive senior lawyers. The firm invests heavily in its people, offering structured development, mentoring, a strong focus on wellbeing, and additional benefits including wellbeing and home office allowances.

About Barratt Galvin
Established in 2014, Barratt Galvin is a specialist legal recruitment consultancy focused on private practice legal recruitment. Laura Barratt, our founder, has been recruiting throughout Australia, the Middle East and the UK since 2005, building deep market knowledge and long-standing relationships across each region.

We partner with leading international and regional law firms to recruit Lawyers, Legal Assistants, Business Development, Marketing, and HR professionals. Recognised for our strength in international law firm recruitment, we regularly advise on moves between the markets within which we recruit.

With strong Sydney and broader Australian market connections, we support both local career progression and international relocation for those seeking opportunities in the Middle East, UK, or beyond.

Barratt Galvin delivers specialist insight, discretion, and access to exclusive opportunities across Australian and global legal markets.

job.title: Paralegal (Emirati)
job.description:
About the Firm
Our client is a leading multinational law firm with a well-established presence in the UAE. Renowned internationally for the calibre of its legal work and its client roster, the firm has built a strong regional reputation across a broad range of practice areas. Its Dubai office offers a collegiate, high-performing environment with genuine opportunities for professional growth.

The Role
We are seeking a Paralegal, who must be a UAE national, to join our client's Dubai office. This is a fantastic opportunity for an Emirati candidate to build a career within a leading international law firm. The role is open across departments, and candidates at all levels of experience are encouraged to apply, from those newly entering the profession through to more experienced paralegals.

Key Responsibilities
  • Supporting lawyers with day-to-day matter management across the department
  • Conducting legal research and assisting with the preparation of legal documents
  • Formatting, proofreading, and preparing correspondence, contracts, and other legal documents
  • Maintaining and organising case and matter files, both physical and electronic
  • Liaising with government authorities, courts, and regulatory bodies as required
  • Assisting with due diligence, document review, and data room preparation
  • Coordinating diaries, deadlines, and filing requirements for the team
  • Providing administrative and client support as needed
Candidate Requirements
  • UAE national (Emirati) — essential
  • Open to all levels of experience, including recent graduates
  • A law degree, paralegal qualification, or relevant tertiary studies is desirable but not essential
  • Excellent written and spoken English; Arabic language skills are an advantage
  • Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail
  • A professional, proactive approach and the ability to manage competing priorities
  • Strong communication skills and a genuine interest in a legal career
Why Apply
This is a rare opportunity to join a leading global law firm in Dubai, with genuine scope for career development and mentorship from senior lawyers. Our client offers a supportive, professional environment and is committed to developing UAE national talent within the firm. Salary is flexible and will be tailored to the successful candidate's experience.

About Barratt Galvin
Established in 2014, Barratt Galvin is a specialist legal recruitment consultancy focused on the Middle East legal market. Laura Barratt, our founder, has been recruiting across the region since 2007, bringing close to two decades of expertise and long-standing relationships with law firms throughout Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Riyadh, Jeddah, and Doha.
We partner with leading international and regional law firms to recruit Lawyers, Legal Assistants, Business Development, Marketing, and HR professionals. We are recognised for our strength in Middle East law firm recruitment and regularly advise on private practice opportunities and broader international law firm business services recruitment across the GCC.
With strong Australian market connections, we support both regional career progression and international relocation.
Barratt Galvin delivers specialist insight, discretion, and access to exclusive opportunities across the Middle East legal sector.
